name: What are the primary types of metal roofing materials available?

mainEntity.name: What are the primary types of metal roofing materials available?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common metal roofing materials include steel (galvanized, Galvalume), aluminum, copper, and zinc. Steel and aluminum are popular due to their durability and cost-effectiveness, while copper and zinc offer exceptional longevity and a distinct aesthetic but at a higher price point. For most residential and commercial properties in the DFW area, steel with a Galvalume coating offers a good balance of performance and value, resisting corrosion well in varying weather conditions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Primary metal roofing materials include steel, aluminum, copper, and zinc. Steel and aluminum are common for their durability and cost-effectiveness, while copper and zinc are premium options.
